data.narrative:
SpectralX is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Asaf Picciotto and IDF special-forces veterans. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of four same-sector, same-stage private companies (Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI), supplemented by reference to two public defense names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and five additional private comparables including Anduril Industries.

Peer-median methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. The four core comparables span a wide range: $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), with a median valuation of $700M. This dispersion reflects material variance in founding pedigree, customer traction, and technology maturity within the cohort. Applying the peer-median method directly yields an implied valuation of $700M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological input; the breadth of the underlying peer distribution ($125M–$4.0B) signals substantial uncertainty around where SpectralX positions relative to Stark Defence's outlier valuation versus the lower quartile represented by NODA AI. Resolution of this range will depend on visibility into customer pipeline, technology differentiation, and the competitive positioning of the company within the defense-tech landscape.
